guarantees.claim: Instance u_aes_masked_inverse_gf2p4 always connects b_buf[5] to its .b port, and drives parent signals q, r, t, b_inv from its corresponding output ports.

assumptions.claim: The synthesis tool must not perform aggressive optimizations that flatten or recombine logic across the aes_masked_inverse_gf2p4_noreuse instance boundary; the masking countermeasure depends on preserving this cell separation.
assumptions.risk: Secret key-dependent intermediate values may leak through power or timing side-channels if the GF(2^4) inverter logic is merged with surrounding circuitry.

uncertain_points.claim: The RTL does not include any logic or synthesis directives to enforce that the aes_masked_inverse_gf2p4_noreuse cell boundary is preserved during optimization, and a missing constraint could expose masked intermediates to SCA.
uncertain_points.cond: If synthesis flattens the hierarchy or recombines logic across the boundary.
uncertain_points.risk: Side-channel leakage of masked AES S-Box inverse values, breaking the masking scheme.
